paragraphs: I'm applying for the Renewables Development Intern role on NYPA's Renewables team. I'm an MBA Finance (STEM) student at Fordham Gabelli, and before that I worked at JPMorgan Asset Management, Lenovo and Thomson Reuters. New York's renewable targets need a lot of new projects built or bought, and NYPA is one of the few places where that work happens at state scale. That is the work I want to learn.

For an MBA project I built project- and portfolio-level models for a 6-project, 35.4 MW Illinois solar portfolio, looking at DSCR, NPV and levered IRR under post-ITC scenarios. I compared senior debt, sustainability-linked loan and green loan plus ABS structures, and the phased green loan and ABS approach we recommended would cut sponsor equity by $11.1M and raise levered IRR from 8.58% to 9.79%. At Lenovo I spent two years building forecasts and scenario analyses that improved capital efficiency by 15%.

The posting talks about data gathering, economic due diligence and market intelligence. That is the part I can help with from day one: pulling the numbers together in Excel, testing the economics of a project, and turning it into something the team can use in PowerPoint. I'd welcome the chance to talk about the summer program.

outreach: Hi [Name], I'm an MBA Finance (STEM) student at Fordham Gabelli and I'm applying for NYPA's Renewables Development internship. For an MBA project I modeled a 35.4 MW solar portfolio (DSCR, NPV, levered IRR) and compared green loan and ABS financing options. I'd love to hear what the Renewables team works on day to day. Would you have 15 minutes for a quick chat?
